events.credibility_reason: Several signals together: the author says 'There are most likely errors in this work'; the result is conditional on an unproved axiom and hypothesis; Sothanaphan identified a gap and an Aristotle run left three holes including the independence assumption; DanielLarsen says a key link is unexplained; Tao's request for a human-readable account went unanswered; no uptake in ~9 months and the Erdős page still reads open with 0 proof claims; pseudonymous forum author on a landmark problem.
events.ai_basis: The proof was generated using Archivara and Aristotle, with a human bridging the final gap through the appendix.

Preprint not located; content known only from a summarising fetch of a forum post.
The three papers were not located; the omega(lcm) >= 9 bound and the three-prime-divisor noncoverage result are known only from a summarising fetch of a forum post, with no engagement.

why: The statement is a yes/no existence question. Excluding coverings with lcm up to 10^4 (Mian–Siddique) or below 11,486,475 (egeozturk) amounts to ruling out finitely many candidate systems, so I scored these as instances rather than bounds. The Mian–Siddique quote ('Development was carried out with the assistance of Claude') does not say Claude produced any mathematics, and the authors call the content folklore, so its AI role is none. Schroeder's omega(lcm) >= 9 applies to all coverings, so it is a genuine bound, but it rests only on a summarised forum post, hence doubtful. gebyjaff's AI role is generated on the author's own wording, but the claim depends on an unproved axiom and has several specific gaps identified by named people, with the author themself expecting errors, so I set it aside as not_credible. I chose not_credible over doubtful because so many signals line up. jinooklee conceded that a key axiom is false, so it is knocked_down. BBMST 2019 settles the square-free case negatively. I gave it direction refuted on the reading that the question asks for existence, but it falls before the snapshot.
doubts: Whether Mian–Siddique should be 'bound' (lower bound on the minimal lcm) rather than 'instances' is a close call. If bound, its AI role would still be none. Schroeder's bound counts toward the status only on the strength of an unverified forum summary. Hough–Nielsen was scored none because it is a necessary condition that moves no quantity. Bloom recording the BBMST result was not treated as digestion.
